dimensions.name: Molecular Weight Explanation
dimensions.description: Are different molecular weights of HA explained (low, medium, high) and their penetration depth?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No mention. 3: 'Hyaluronic acid'. 5: 'Multi-molecular' or 'multi-weight'. 7: Weight types with surface vs deep hydration. 10: Full molecular weight breakdown with skin layer targeting explanation.

dimensions.name: Hydration Duration Claims
dimensions.description: Are long-lasting hydration claims made with specific timeframes?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No claims. 3: 'Hydrating'. 5: 'Long-lasting hydration'. 7: Specific hours (24h, 48h, 72h). 10: Specific duration with testing methodology or clinical backing.

dimensions.name: Concentration Transparency
dimensions.description: Is the HA concentration or percentage disclosed?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No concentration. 3: 'High concentration'. 5: Percentage stated. 7: Percentage with why that level. 10: Percentage with optimal concentration explanation for efficacy vs stickiness.

dimensions.name: Layering Guidance
dimensions.description: Is guidance provided for layering with other products and application on damp skin?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No guidance. 3: 'Apply to face'. 5: 'Apply to damp skin'. 7: Damp skin + layering order. 10: Full application protocol including humidity considerations and product pairing.

dimensions.name: Complementary Ingredients
dimensions.description: Are combination ingredients highlighted (ceramides, B5/panthenol, niacinamide, glycerin)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: None. 3: One mentioned. 5: 2-3 mentioned. 7: Synergy explained. 10: Full ingredient synergy map with hydration-locking explanation.

dimensions.name: Texture & Sensory
dimensions.description: Is texture described (lightweight, gel-like, non-sticky, fast-absorbing)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No description. 5: Basic texture. 10: Full sensory profile including finish and under-makeup compatibility.

dimensions.name: Skin Type Targeting
dimensions.description: Is suitability for specific skin types and concerns addressed?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No targeting. 5: 'All skin types'. 10: Specific type suitability with dehydration vs dry skin distinction.

dimensions.name: Certifications
dimensions.description: Are vegan, cruelty-free, fragrance-free, paraben-free stated?

dimensions.name: Outcome Specificity
dimensions.description: Are specific hydration outcomes promised (plumping, fine line reduction, dewy finish, barrier repair)?
dimensions.scoring_criteria: 0: No outcomes. 5: Generic. 10: Specific outcomes with visible timeline.
